notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Alena do not have summoning sickness.
You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Alena.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.
